thinking:
We need to produce BPMN XML model with one pool (organisation) and lanes for each actor. Actors: Coordination Unit at the Town Planning Authority, Support Officer, independent Committee Members (multiple, but can be one lane). So lanes: Coordination Unit, Support Officer, Committee Members.

Process steps:

1. Start event.

2. Coordination Unit drafts schedule of meetings for next calendar year and adds draft dates to all calendars. This is a task: "Draft schedule of meetings for next calendar year and add draft dates to all calendars". Name includes verb and object. We'll call task "Draft schedule of meetings for next calendar year and add draft dates to all calendars". It belongs to Coordination Unit lane.

3. Support Officer checks the dates and suggests modifications. Task: "Check dates and suggest modifications". Lane: Support Officer.

4. Coordination Unit rechecks all dates and looks for potential conflicts. Task: "Recheck all dates and look for potential conflicts". Lane: Coordination Unit.

5. Decision? The schedule is sent to all independent Committee Members by email. That seems like a task: "Send final schedule of meeting dates to all independent Committee Members by email". Lane: Coordination Unit.

6. Committee Members check diaries and advise Coordination Unit of any conflicts. Task: "Check diaries and advise Coordination Unit of any conflicts". Lane: Committee Members.

Potential decision: maybe after they advise, process ends? But there may be loop if conflicts found. Not described. We'll end with end event after Committee advice.

There is no branching; all sequential.

Thus model: start -> draft task -> check task -> recheck task -> send schedule task -> committee check/task -> end.

We need BPMN XML without diagram elements. Provide definitions, collaboration with participant referencing process.

Also need laneSet with lanes and flowNodeRef for each node.

We need IDs for each element.

We need to ensure names start with step numbers? Not required unless description has step numbers; it doesn't. So we can ignore numbering.

But the skill says name of every element starts with step number if description has step numbers; not the case.

Thus produce XML with start event, tasks, end event.

Add a sequence flow between each.

Need to put each node into exactly one lane.

Let's generate IDs: start event ID "Start". Task IDs: "Task_1", "Task_2", "Task_3", "Task_4", "Task_5". End event ID "End". Gateways not needed.

We'll need laneSet ID "LANESET". Lanes: CoordinationUnitLane ID "Lane_CoordinationUnit", SupportOfficerLane ID "Lane_SupportOfficer", CommitteeMembersLane ID "Lane_CommitteeMembers". Each lane lists the node IDs.

Mapping:

Coordination Unit tasks: Task_1 (draft), Task_3 (recheck), Task_4 (send schedule). Also maybe initial start? Usually start event is not assigned to lane? It can be placed in a lane; but we can place it in Coordination Unit lane.

We'll assign start event to Coordination Unit lane.

Support Officer lane: Task_2.

Committee members lane: Task_5 and End.

Need to include flowNodeRef for each element ID.

Provide process with isExecutable="false".

Let's craft XML accordingly.

  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="ORG_POOL" name="Town Planning Authority" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANESET">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CoordinationUnit" name="Coordination Unit">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_4</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SupportOfficer" name="Support Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CommitteeMembers" name="Committee Members">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_5</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Start" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_1" name="Draft schedule of meetings for next calendar year and add draft dates to all calendars" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_2" name="Check dates and suggest modifications" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_3" name="Recheck all dates and look for potential conflicts" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_4" name="Send final schedule of meeting dates to all independent Committee Members by email" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_5" name="Check diaries and advise Coordination Unit of any conflicts" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_1" targetRef="Task_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_2" targetRef="Task_3" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_3" targetRef="Task_4" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_4" targetRef="Task_5" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_5" targetRef="End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
